subject: german
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in German on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (German↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: How do you say 'I play football'?
questions.explain: 'Fußball spielen' = 'to play football'. 'Klavier spielen' would be 'to play piano'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I have to revise for my exams'?
options: Ich habe Lust auf meine Prüfungen
Ich muss für meine Prüfungen lernen
questions.explain: 'Lernen' here means 'to study/revise' and 'müssen' = 'to have to', so this means 'I have to revise for my exams'.
'Das Wohlbefinden' means 'wellbeing'. ('Die Wohnung' = flat — a near-miss distractor.)
'Vermeiden' = 'to avoid' and 'Süßigkeiten' = 'sweets', so this is 'I avoid sweets'.
'Das Schlagzeug' means 'the drum kit' (from 'schlagen' = to hit).

questions.q: What does 'Ich treffe mich mit Freunden' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sich treffen mit' means 'to meet up with', so this is 'I meet up with friends'.
'Angeln' means 'to fish/go angling' (from 'die Angel' = fishing rod).

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We have to wear a uniform'?
questions.explain: 'Tragen' here means 'to wear' and 'müssen' = 'to have to', so this is 'We have to wear a uniform'.

questions.q: What does 'ausgewogen' mean (e.g. of a diet)?
questions.explain: 'Ausgewogen' means 'balanced', as in 'eine ausgewogene Ernährung' = 'a balanced diet'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I spend too much time online'?
options: Ich verbringe zu viel Geld online
Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit online
questions.explain: 'Zeit verbringen' = 'to spend time' and 'zu viel' = 'too much', so this means 'I spend too much time online'.
'Das Fach' means 'a (school) subject', e.g. 'mein Lieblingsfach' = 'my favourite subject'.
'Die Ganztagsschule' means 'an all-day school' (with afternoon lessons too).
